<js>
let document = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(result);
let chapters = document.select(".book-chapter a");
let chapterData = [];
let invalidChapterFound = false;

chapters.forEach((item) => {
    let title = item.text();
    let href = item.attr("href");
    let chapterNumberMatch = title.match(/第(\d+)章/);

    if (!chapterNumberMatch) {
        // 检测到无效章节，标记为不合法
        invalidChapterFound = true;
    } else {
        let chapterNumber = parseInt(chapterNumberMatch[1], 10);
        chapterData.push({
            number: chapterNumber,
            text: title,
            href: href
        });
     }
});

if (book.getVariable("custom")!=""&&invalidChapterFound==false) {
	   java.toast("目录乱序修复已开启")
    chapterData.sort((a, b) => a.number - b.number);
} else {
    chapterData = []
    chapters.forEach((item) => (chapterData.push({
        text: item.text(),
        href: item.attr("href")
    })));
}
chapterData
</js>

]

	{	title: '　全部　', type: 0},
	{	title: '玄幻奇幻', type: 1},
	{	title: '仙侠武侠', type: 2},
	{	title: '都市言情', type: 3},
	{	title: '穿越历史', type: 4},
	{	title: '科幻灵异', type: 5},
	{	title: '  藏经阁  ', type: 6},
	{	title: '其他类别', type: 7}
]
//排序
novelRank = [
	{ title: '  更新  ', type: 'lastupdate'},
	{ title: '总人气', type: 'allvisit'},
	{ title: '月人气', type: 'monthvisit'},
	{ title: '  字数  ', type: 'size'},
	{ title: '  新书  ', type: 'postdate'}
]

list = [];
formatUrl = (sort, rank, state) => {
	return `{{eval(String(source.loginUrl));_getUrl();}}shuku/${sort}-${rank}-${state}-{{page}}.html`;
}
pushItem = (title, url, basis) => {
	list.push({
		title: title,
		url: url,
		style: {
			layout_flexGrow: 1,
			layout_flexBasisPercent: basis
		}
	});
}

for (stateItem of novelState) {
	pushItem(`🚫小说状态---${stateItem.title}🚫`, "", 1);
	for (rankItem of novelRank) {
		novelSort[0].title = "📫" + rankItem.title;
		for (sortItem of novelSort) {
			pushItem(`${sortItem.title}`, formatUrl(sortItem.type, rankItem.type, stateItem.type), sortItem.type > 5 ? 0.45 : 0.25);
		}
	}
}
JSON.stringify(list);
</js>
